emergencyProcedures.title: Medical Emergency
emergencyProcedures.summary: Immediate protocol for severe illness, injury, or unconscious individual.
steps: Call 911 immediately and notify Campus Security Dispatch at (555) 010-4357.
Do NOT move the injured person unless there is immediate danger (fire, toxic fumes).
Send someone to meet first responders at the building entrance.
Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs) are stationed adjacent to elevators on each floor.
Stay on the line with emergency dispatch until medical personnel arrive on scene.

emergencyProcedures.title: Fire & Building Evacuation
emergencyProcedures.summary: Immediate steps upon hearing the alarm or detecting smoke/fire.
steps: Activate the nearest pull station alarm immediately.
Evacuate via the nearest marked emergency stairwell. NEVER use elevators during a fire alarm.
Close doors behind you to compartmentalize smoke and flames.
Assemble at the designated outdoor assembly point at least 150 feet away from the structure.
Do not re-enter the facility until the campus fire marshal issues an official all-clear.

emergencyProcedures.title: Severe Weather & Shelter-in-Place
emergencyProcedures.summary: Procedures for tornadic activity, severe storm warnings, or flash flooding.
steps: Move to the lowest interior level of the building away from external windows, glass doors, and skylights.
Restrooms, interior basements, and reinforced central stairwells offer maximum shelter.
Monitor university emergency SMS alerts for radar updates and campus operational status.
Remain in shelter until the emergency broadcast system declares the storm warning expired.

emergencyProcedures.title: Security Concern & Active Threat
emergencyProcedures.summary: Protocol for suspicious activity, trespass, or active campus threats.
steps: RUN: If an accessible escape path exists, evacuate the area immediately.
HIDE: If escape is not possible, lock and barricade the door, turn off lights, and silence mobile phones.
FIGHT: As an absolute last resort when your life is in imminent danger, attempt to disrupt or incapacitate the threat.
Use campus Blue Light emergency poles located every 100 yards for 1-touch police dispatch.
Call (555) 010-4357 or text university silent dispatch if you cannot speak safely.
